comment: Pinned downloads of the Java oracle (tools/oracle/fetch.ps1). Everything is downloaded at run time into %LOCALAPPDATA%\gf-oracle (or $env:GF_ORACLE_HOME) and verified by SHA-256; nothing here is ever committed. The upstream jar is only loaded by the server: no file is ever extracted from it (rules R10, R11).

upstream.provenance: The universal jar of version 4.8.3802 that the upstream CI published (the last 1.21.1-branch build; NeoForge 21.1.209 as in the upstream gradle.properties). Its download URL is not kept here: set GF_ORACLE_UPSTREAM_URL to it (see NOTICE for the upstream project); the SHA-256 above verifies it. Verified once when pinned: all 1566 .java files of its -sources.jar are byte-identical to src/main/java of the pinned commit; the commits after the last code change touch only build files and one .nbt template.
